name: Unlimited Liability Clause
description: Agreement lacks standard limitation of liability caps.
recommendation: Insert a liability cap tied to 12 months of fees paid.

name: Broad Indemnification Scope
patterns: indemnify from any and all claims
description: Indemnification obligations are unilateral or overly broad.
recommendation: Mutualize indemnification and scope to third-party claims only.

name: Short Notice Termination for Convenience
description: Short notice window allows counterparties to terminate unexpectedly.
recommendation: Standardize termination notice period to at least 30–60 days.

name: Automatic IP Assignment
patterns: assign all right title and interest
description: Sweeping work-for-hire or pre-existing IP transfer clauses.
recommendation: Explicitly exclude pre-existing IP and background tools.
